q: At what temperature does the ice melt?
For how long did the temperature stay at 0 °C?
Energy was supplied all the time. Explain why the temperature stayed at 0 °C.
The energy was used to break the forces between particles (melting), not to make them move faster.
Use the particle model to explain the shape of the graph after 12 minutes.
At 100 °C the water boils: energy separates the particles into a gas, so the temperature stays flat until all the water has boiled.
